name: Blender vs. Juicer
instruction: Design a 3D model comparing a blender and a juicer. The blender should have a tall container with blades at the bottom, while the juicer should have a spout for juice and a separate container for pulp. Position them side by side.

Shape accuracy: The blender has a tall cylindrical container.
The blender features blades positioned at the bottom.
The juicer has a spout for dispensing juice.
The juicer includes a separate container for collecting pulp.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The blender's container is taller than the juicer's components.
The size of the pulp container is appropriate relative to the juicer.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The blender and juicer are positioned side by side.
The blades in the blender are correctly placed at the bottom.
The spout of the juicer is oriented outward for easy access.
The separate pulp container is adjacent to the juicer.
Object distance and contact: There is adequate space between the blender and juicer for visual clarity.
The base of the blender does not overlap with the juicer's components.
The spout of the juicer does not interfere with the blender's container.

Instruction execution accuracy: Both the blender and juicer are accurately represented as per the instructions.
The specific features of each appliance are included as described.
